fails_if: entity-key-pins keys a pin on the variable slug or the bare var_id instead of the partition member's native id, resolves only the first element of a composite key, pins a register the steward dir does not name, or writes a block the slug loader cannot read
note: From the artifact curation: variant 1.10 carries the composite key [value, kon] (variables 1.101 and 1.102); variant 4.40 carries `lopnr`, the slug of partition member 4.7.lopnrny (its native id names its column, not its slug); variant 3.30 carries `komvux`, but the steward dir names only registers 1 and 4. So the pins are 1.101, 1.102 and 4.7.lopnrny, numeric-aware, in one scb file; they reload as exactly those slugs.
